basis: The bundled engine ran on Homey Pro (2023) with a Pexar PX-110. External tests confirmed a video still, a caption, a photo receipt with custom crop parameters and accepted display requests. The visible crop and awake-screen photo change remain to be verified. An observed display request during standby did not wake this frame.
candidateChecks: Homey publish-level package validation, JavaScript tests and native Go tests using simulated frames on Windows.
